description:
Where a collateral token is used across the lending venues we read:
    per venue and chain, supply and borrow against it and its share of the
    venue's supply. Supply/borrow are the markets' loan-side totals attributed
    to the collateral token (a footprint proxy, not collateral posted). Phantom /
    single-actor flagged markets are listed, not summed. A symbol matching several
    tokens returns them separately (ambiguous=true).
name: basis_asset_footprint
